text:
Sasha: Quick sync on the Newton customer incident (VPC peering flaps + agent reconnects). Root cause: intermittent peering route churn combined with aggressive agent reconnect backoff. Need clear owners and timelines for remediation.
Ana: Proposed breakdown: (A) peering config & routing audit, (B) on-prem agent resilience + logs, (C) temporary mitigation and canary rollout.
Mike: I can own the peering audit. Will run the peering checklist in staging, capture diffs vs prod, and open RD-3490. ETA: EOD Thu.
Dilip: I'll pick up agent diagnostics and a code change to add jitter and better backoff. Need the full agent logs to reproduce the reconnect loop.
Juniper: Uploading logs: s3://redwood-cust/newton/logs/agent-2151234000.tar.gz. Noted repeated 502s and kernel drops around 02:16 UTC.
Sasha: Short-term mitigation idea: enable a scoped public fallback for telemetry/health only (flag `monitor_only_public_fallback=true`). Who can run a canary?
Mike: I'll run the canary: 10% nodes tonight, monitor error rates for 2 hours, then ramp if stable. Will post dashboard link.
Ana: I'll update the postmortem with owners, timelines, and mark this as a recurring pattern to monitor weekly until cleared.
Dilip: Created RD-3491 for the agent backoff fix (PR forthcoming). Target: merge & hotfix in next sprint.
oncall-bot: Reminder: incident follow-up sync Thu 16:00 UTC — Zoom https://zoom.redwood/incident-followup
Juniper: Clarify: will the fallback route any customer inference payload over the internet? Need security confirmation.
Sasha: Fallback limited to telemetry & health-check endpoints only; no inference payloads or PII. We'll document exact endpoints.
Ana: Security approved scoped monitoring-only fallback (sec@redwood). I'll attach sign-off to the postmortem.
Mike: Canary results: error rate dropped from ~18% to ~2% within 30m for canary group. Dashboard: internal link shared in #rd-dash.
Dilip: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood/agent/pull/1002 — reduces reconnect aggressiveness and adds better logs. Needs final review.
Sasha: Owner recap: peering audit — Mike (RD-3490); agent fix — Dilip (RD-3491); canary/rollout — Mike; postmortem & sec attachments — Ana; weekly triage — Sasha. Target completion: 2026-04-08.
Juniper: Thanks. We'll keep monitoring from Newton and report anomalies.
Sasha: I'll notify the customer with the mitigation summary and link the updated postmortem once Ana posts it. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Ana: Adding note in postmortem: "Observed pattern: intermittent BGP/peering instability correlated with kernel-level drops on on-prem hosts" for future detection.
Mike: Playbook update: add a step to validate route propagation and MTU/AS path verification before marking isolation resolved. I'll add to infra-playbooks.
Dilip: After PR merge I'll cut a hotfix and coordinate deployment with Mike's rollout window.
Sasha: If anything slips, escalate to oncall SRE and we'll reassign. I'll move actions into Jira and close the loop.
